== Original printed-face source; card data unchanged ==
Added the [https://web.archive.org/web/20080512224547/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/sandcrawlerdroidjunkheap.html archived original Decipher card page] as an explicitly labeled original printed-face source. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20050319041354im_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/sandcrawlerdroidjunkheap.gif original black-border scan] and current wiki image were visually checked. The bare Scomp reference for the existing vehicle-site rulings was replaced with archived official rules: Decipher Glossary Version 2.0, p. 136 (vehicle sites and loss of their cards), and Players Committee 2023 Advanced Rulebook, p. 85 (deployment, adjacency, related locations and planet-site distinction). The original card face supplies the ownership-specific deployment text. All ruling prose is unchanged; the rules references are separate from the printed-face source. Other existing secondary sources are retained. No game text, lore, stats, icons, UID, version label, image, printings or sibling page was changed; the citation does not certify the current data as identical to the original face. == English errata comparison ==
The comparison separates the printed English face from independently sourced Decipher and PC replacements. The original English face has one uniqueness dot. Glossary Version 2.0, p. 116, changes the Dark Side wording while retaining the original uniqueness. Appendix A, p. 127, expressly changes uniqueness to restricted (•••). The intermediate documentary article has no allocated gameplay ID and no substituted card image. Source: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], p. 116. Comparison: [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, p. 127. Existing gameplay identifiers are retained. Japanese, Revised, foil and virtual articles are outside this English comparison.
